procedures.scope: Declared suffix, two C22 ID reads, application-supplied address and observed UNKNOWN mode.
procedures.acceptance: All four declarations accept 2000 A240. Reject zero/ones, wrong OUI/model and every other revision. Keep local invalid requests free of I/O.

procedures.scope: Sample SOR1/SOR2 after a strap-latching reset. Pin resistors, supplies and clocks belong to the board; the driver may report their latched selections.
procedures.acceptance: Decode each four-level strap using its own pin table. LED_0/1 modes 2/3 enter test mode. Test address 0 through 31 and the unstrapped default 1.
procedures.boardReference: SNLU179 pp.4,7,14: J6 supply jumpers and J13/J14 MAC pin/strap access on the TI evaluation module. An installed transceiver, jumper state, rail and optical SD pin require an identified board.

procedures.scope: Own whole C22 and MMD transactions across bus participants. Vendor alias for standard 00..1F except the direct-only selectors. Use DEVAD 31 for vendor locations, 3/7 for their printed IEEE locations. Gate raw access to destructive data, holes and selectors.
procedures.acceptance: Read 703D with 0D=0007, 0E=003D, 0D=4007, read 0E. For vendor alias 0017 substitute 001F,0017,401F. Reject post-increment and indirect selector aliases.
procedures.functions: Function 11 increments after writes only in section 7.4.2.1; function 10 is contradicted. Driver policy uses 00 then 01 for every data transfer. Address readback is an owner-only selector transaction.
procedures.busTiming: Board/controller constraint: keep SMI inactive for at least one MDC cycle after reset release as well as observing reset stabilization and preamble timing. MDIO is sampled on rising MDC. Section 6.9 gives 2.5 MHz typical, 25 MHz maximum, 0..10 ns PHY output delay and 10 ns minimum input setup and hold. Read turnaround Z0, write turnaround 10. Clock may stop while idle.

procedures.scope: Track five reset domains and observed completion. Invalidate trust across uncertain writes, re-read affected defaults/straps, restore only persistent owned settings and invalidate cached link.
procedures.acceptance: Compare all resetDomains records. POR readiness, reset pulse, post-release SMI stabilization and FLP acquisition have distinct anchors. Do not convert typical FLP time to a deadline.

procedures.scope: 10BASE-Te and 100BASE-TX forced half/full, 10-Mbit threshold/squelch, NLP, jabber, polarity, error and link observation. Use copper-only controls on declared copper. Couple PHYSTS mirror reads to collector observations.
procedures.acceptance: PHYSTS 0001,0005,0003,0007 give 100/half,100/full,10/half,10/full while linked. Retain first latched-low BMSR read and current second read independently. Squelch codes 0..8 cover 200..600 mV.

procedures.scope: Copper advertisement, pause/asymmetric pause, parallel detection, fast AN, selection, restart, manual next-page exchange and retained partner ability. Distinguish local values, partner data and resolved operating mode.
procedures.acceptance: Cover all four abilities, no common setting, next-page ACK/toggle, pause intersections, and unresolved no-link. Fast timer codes come from the embedded table. Use the DP83822 ANAR wording.
procedures.localRemoteFault: Table 8-5 permits local ANAR[13] to advertise a detected remote fault. This differs from the local advertisement prohibition on DP83825/26. Table 8-6 ANLPAR[13] is an independent observation.

procedures.scope: Copper auto/manual MDI and crossover, force/robust/fast modes and observed pair status depend on straps and speed/AN choices.
procedures.acceptance: Test PHYCR[15:14] including both manual directions, CR1[6:5], CR3 applicable controls, and preservation of partial configuration after a failed transfer.

procedures.scope: Enable fast-link-drop criteria, retain the latched reason and constrain copper recovery/threshold controls. SNLA438 table 3-3 gives the 100/full PROFINET example; the separate cable-break profile changes DSP state.
procedures.acceptance: Test the independent CR3 mask/reason pairs and a consumed event followed by failed I/O. Example AN 3100/0101 or forced 2100, CR2 copper 0080 or fiber 4080, CR3 100F, restart 4000. On FX skip copper advertisement and choose forced 100 per §7.4.6.
procedures.useOfExamples: SNLA438 table 3-3 contains whole words including reserved lanes (e.g. CR2[7]). Retain the example for comparison and compose only the exact documented fields in ordinary mode selection. Do not advertise copper modes in FX.

procedures.scope: PHYSCR pin, polarity, output and test, MISR1/2 enable bytes and event bytes. Only the collector reads the live words. Track RXFS[12] selection and side effects after WoL enable.
procedures.acceptance: Exercise all 16 sources, RC/W low-byte semantics, routing and read order with a failed second MISR read. MISR2[9] depends on the selector, which resets zero. After each collector read, exercise the unresolved enable-retention case separately from the consumed high-byte event.

procedures.scope: Single collector for latched and read-clear link/AN, error counter, FLD, FIFO, PRBS, LPI, wake and interrupt evidence. Track cross-register clear and preserve partial samples and uncertain intervals.
procedures.acceptance: FCSCR saturates at FF, RECR at FFFF. 3016 is DEVAD 3 offset 0016, read/clear. No counter or health poll outside the collector. Test read order and retained output after each fault.

procedures.scope: Select MII, RMII leader/follower, RGMII, FIFO threshold, enhanced RMII, reference/receive clock, sync, isolation and collision behavior. Software RMII entry and strap-selected RMII differ.
procedures.acceptance: Exercise 25 MHz MII/leader/RGMII and 50 MHz follower against the strap table. Before software RMII entry inspect 0462 owners; RCSR[5] then 0462=4300 then 001F=4000. Entered by strap, omit that recipe. Qualify lower mux restoration and reverse transition. On RMII exit restore 0462[10:8]=0 with an owned masked update, then restart (inferred). Reject incompatible input clock or pin owner before mutation.
procedures.rgmiiInBand: MAC observes RX_D[3:0] only with RX_DV low: bit 3 full duplex, bits 2:1 speed (00=10 Mb/s at 2.5 MHz, 01=100 Mb/s at 25 MHz, other codes reserved), bit 0 link. Test 0x9 for 10/full/up and 0x3 for 100/half/up, and ignore data during receive. RX_CLK can stretch when switching reference or speed. In-band MAC pins do not perform a PHY register read.

procedures.scope: Fixed 3.5 ns RCSR RX/TX choices; MII TXCPSR phase action and 4 ns difference steps. Clock outputs on 0462/0463 require pin ownership. FAST_RXDV timing footnotes name an extra vendor word.
procedures.acceptance: Under 1800 both off/on choices yield 0800,1800,0000,1000 in RX/TX order. For MII code 2 to 9, expect 28 ns. Pin selector values 3/5 reserved; GPIO1 clock function uses [2:0]=3; reject an active FX SD owner.

procedures.scope: IF/HF forced 100BASE-FX half/full over MII/RMII. Separate CR2 enable, latched SD wiring, SD polarity and actual optical link. Explicit maintenance refresh may restart then double-read BMSR. RGMII/FX remains open.
procedures.acceptance: For both F grades set bit 14 using mask/value 4000; cross SOR1[11:10] 01/10 and [9:8] 10/11. Check both duplexes, blocked I/H, separate cache/maintenance paths and no writes to CR1[6:5], PHYCR[15:14], CR3[6:5] or copper-only diagnostics. For wired SD confirm module polarity before insertion. Apply 0465[0]=1 beforehand for active-low valid signal, or 0 for active-high. Wrong polarity can invert the link indication.

procedures.scope: Own far-end fault generation/detection disable controls and force-100 link control. Preserve reserved bits, distinguish an artificially forced link and received optical signal.
procedures.source: SNLS505H §7.4.4 and table 8-35; SNLA479 tables 1-5 and 2-1
procedures.acceptance: Use mask 2060 with individual [13,6,5] choices and a nonzero prior word. Copper applicability of bit 13 is unconfirmed. With generation disabled (0040[6]), local RX loss can leave the peer up. With detection disabled ([5]), local TX loss can leave the local indication up after the peer goes down. Observe both ends independently.

procedures.scope: Fiber line swing in LDCTRL[11:8], shared access owner with electrical. Require an F declaration and FX media for optical amplitude settings.
procedures.acceptance: Check all 16 FX codes including code 13=976 mVpp, code 15=1033 mVpp. Restore copper fields independently and measure output on an identified optical fixture.

procedures.scope: MII, PCS input/output, digital, analog and reverse loopback, external loop fixture and 100M transmit-in-MII-loopback option. Suspend conflicting AN/MDIX before local loopbacks and restore on stop.
procedures.source: SNLS505H §7.4.8 and tables 8-1/22; SNLA437A §§2.5.2/.3; SNLA479 table 1-5
procedures.acceptance: Compare BMCR[14] and BISCR modes 01,02,04,08,10. Check speed restriction on BISCR[6], 100-ohm copper analog termination and ignored MAC input in reverse. Reject simultaneous incompatible loops. For IF/HF on FX exercise 0016[4] reverse loopback with a peer. Other copper-loop fixtures require their own medium evidence.

procedures.scope: Independent PRBS checker, generator, continuous/single count, lock, sync loss, packet size, raw IPG and finite error-count capture. Restore previous diagnostics/traffic state. Cable loop requires an admitted fixture.
procedures.acceptance: For analog example: hard reset, forced 2100, BISCR=0108, 030B=3380, BISCR=3108, capture example, read count. In two-PHY example force 100/full on each, BISCR 7100 locally and 0110 at partner. Sample BISCR[11]/[10]/[9] through collector and report incomplete intervals.
procedures.interval: SNLA437A 2.5.3 gives a minimum one-second observation in the partner reverse-loop test. The delay begins only after generation and partner loopback are established. It supplies no guaranteed lock deadline.

procedures.scope: Manual TDR and link-down autorun on copper, with disconnected/quiet partner. Own TD/RD bypass, cross mode, averaging and pulse/listening controls. Preserve raw five-peak maps for each pair and report completion/failure before conversion.
procedures.acceptance: Apply 0171[3:0]=C,0173[15:8]=FF,0177[12:8]=18 in order; then manual CDCR[15] or CR1[8] auto. Require start clear AND done set, fail clear; Done resets one. Ignore invalid C samples. 33 hex gives about 36.31 m per the guide; use 7-bit raw amplitudes and 018A polarity/excess flags.

procedures.scope: Live copper cable diagnostic uses ALCDRR1 start/status, sum out, PGA code and FAGC accumulator. Persistent tuning and transient commands have separate ownership.
procedures.acceptance: Start 0155[15], busy 0155[12]=1 and complete=0. Capture [11:4], 0215[3:0],021D[11:0]. A reset-default completion level alone cannot prove a fresh result. Retain raw codes until a validated conversion is supplied.

procedures.scope: Observe channel A raw MSE at vendor 0218 when linked; report guide bands for that measurement. Separate raw MSE and hardware thresholds. Preserve sample validity on link loss.
procedures.acceptance: Test samples 0209,020A,033B,033C across both boundaries. No writes, assumed reset value, invented dB conversion or alias to a threshold.

procedures.scope: Own documented DSP/DFE/AGC, thresholds, timers, timing loop, analog equalizer and calibration controls. Split named fields from reserved R/W cells and literal-only cable-break overrides.
procedures.acceptance: Verify each field partition, documented legal settings and units. 0101[6:0] unlisted. Compare normal tuning with whole-word recipe paths; preserve unqualified fields and obtain exact safe operating ranges.

procedures.scope: Copper PROFINET cable-break diagnostic profile under exclusive maintenance. Hard reset first, ordered DSP/FLD/filter/timer writes, optional EEE-off step, digital restart last. Changes include reserved/unlisted fields across owners 63,66,67. Use sequence-level admission and retained restoration.
procedures.acceptance: Verify the 22 indexed recipe words (21 without optional 04D1). In particular 0107=0605 and 04D4=3322 are recipe-only at wholly reserved addresses. Require documented reset/restoration after partial execution; cable-break measurements require an identified break machine and partner.
procedures.evidence: SNLA383 table 3-1 contains TI fixture measurements under the stated forced/AN copper conditions. It does not establish host execution or project measurements for any declaration.
procedures.fixtureCriteria: SNLA383 §3 evaluates both endpoints: detect disruption in less than 15 us and remain down throughout it. After release, stable link within 30 ms forced or 5 s AN, with no further drops. These criteria belong to the TI cable-break test.

procedures.scope: Line driver amplitudes for each valid medium (FX swing shared with 65), Class A/B MLT-3, impedance and analog supplies. Interpret rail overrides only against the identified board.
procedures.acceptance: Check all 16 unrounded impedance codes, 99.25 to 42.51 ohms, TX and 10BASE-Te voltage tables, 0404=0020/0024. Read 0421 supply levels before considering explicit 041F override. Software cannot set board supply voltages.
procedures.wireExample: Section 7.4.2.8 writes 0D=001F, 0E=0461, 0D=401F, 0E=0400 for 99.25 ohms. Only [4:1]=0000 selects the impedance. The high value belongs to reserved cells; use field-preserving updates for normal configuration.

procedures.scope: Isolated 100BASE-TX idle and 10BASE-Te pattern modes with AN disabled; staged split-field change, reset/start/stop and verified restoration. Keep harmonic-test conflict open. SNLA266B section 4 is the DP83825-specific VOD procedure; the 22 uses LDCTRL.
procedures.acceptance: TX or NLP recipe resets, uses BMCR=2100 or 0100, PHYCR=0021 or 4021, then 001F=4000. DP83822 10BASE-Te standard adds BISCR=7108 before restart. For a new TX idle value clear 0428[4], position 0428[5] and 0027[3:0], then set enable. Test all 0..31 and all documented 10M patterns.

procedures.scope: RMII back-to-back repeater and collision indication, FIFO depth and board-provided data/clock connections. Coordinate the shared interface owner before start or restoration.
procedures.acceptance: Test both documented topology and clock-role requirements, buffered thresholds and incompatible pin owners. Board loop and reach require a pair of identified PHYs.

procedures.scope: PHYSCR power saving includes active/passive sleep; BMCR IEEE power-down or external pin precedes deep power. Own exit-speed and DPD enable without changing neighboring compliance fields.
procedures.acceptance: Test each documented sleep selection. Enter IEEE first then 0428[2]; 0428[3] chooses exit duration 50 or 100 ms without an identified MAX. Qualify MDIO accessibility and exit/restore on identified hardware.

procedures.scope: Negotiate over copper using next-page advertisements or vendor bypass. Track supplier/partner, current and retained status, wake-error counter, disabled next pages, analog quiet shutdown and stoppable clocks. FX has no AN.
procedures.acceptance: Exercise vendor 04D1 bypass/enable vs 3/0014,7/003C,7/003D under all strap choices. Preserve the exact-part table access for 3/0001 and 3/0016. 100BASE-TX LPI and lower-amplitude 10BASE-Te have different evidence.
procedures.sourceLimits: SNLS505H table 8-133 reserves 04D1[15:4]. SNLA328 explicitly targets DP83825I; its extra 100M tuning words, 04D1[12] host LPI and timing policy have no independent DP83822 grant.

procedures.scope: MAC TX_ER request on the selected pin, clock control and LPI observation through exact MMD3. Application owns MAC quiet time, pin allocation and packet traffic.
procedures.acceptance: 04D0[14] and [6:5] choose request and pin, 01=INT/PWDN_N,10=COL/GPIO,00/11 no pin. Test pin conflicts and negotiated prerequisite. Table 8-133 reserves [15:4]; no DP83825 legacy-MAC register assertion transfers to DP83822.

procedures.scope: Magic, Secure-ON and 64-byte pattern matching, CRC gate, indication pulse/level, packet classification, source selection and acknowledgement. Applies to all supported line speeds including FX on F parts.
procedures.acceptance: Test little-endian byte pairs, byte 0/63, all four ignore masks, offset 0/12/63, all pulse widths and CRC/level indications. Use owned RXFCFG1 + 0800 to clear, e.g. 0181 to 0981. RXFS[12] resets 0; enabling WoL sets it. Compose selector writes with all eight RXFS status lanes zero, including reserved [4:2]. Section 8 defines RH/W1S for events. No software set/clear action is specified for this byte.

wireExamples.source: SNLA261A tables 2-6 and 2-10, DP83822 examples. Octet zero is the leftmost byte of each input. Words are in ascending register order.

procedures.scope: Own LED source, polarity, blink, active-stretch and manual control, MLED routing and GPIO mux/pin conflicts with clocks, data, signal-detect, IRQ and wake. Strap defaults are observed inputs.
procedures.acceptance: Test each documented code, reserved exclusions and exclusive MLED selection (LED_0 or COL). In RGMII/MII conserve RX_D3 data. Distinguish electrical polarity from logical LED selection and retain a consumed link-lost indication.

procedures.scope: Expose RX/TX delimiter indication, PTPPSEL pin routing, PTPCFG phase controls, IOCTRL muxes and ancillary WoL aid. Timestamp collection stays external. PTPCFG also contains DSP timer controls.
procedures.acceptance: Require confirmed MII and compatible IPG owner before any pin change. After routing the pins, use 0456=000A. The optional source example 04A0=1080 enables WoL with CRC gating and all packet filters off. For an owned update preserve the existing CRC/filter policy, set bit 7 and keep the clear action at bit 11 zero. If active wake filters would acquire a new effect, require their owner. Finish with 001F=4000. Test both branches, RXFS[12], partial restoration and zero mutations on unqualified interfaces.
procedures.pinOwners: Prompt 67 composes 003E/003F. Coordinate 003F[9:8] with MAC TX_ER pin assignment and [7:4] with the prompt-66 cable-break profile. The timer has no independent scale.

recipes.scope: 100BASE-TX measurement condition for MII receive, both RMII paths and both RGMII paths. The MII transmit row has no FAST_RXDV footnote. Coordinate all CR1 owners. Only the RGMII rows add 0457=0410.
Opaque second word for the RGMII 100BASE-TX latency measurement only. Reset/restoration of this unlisted word requires confirmation.

Analog PRBS example with IPG code 7D. Capture then read 001B. General capture uses owned low IPG, sets bit 15 once, and consumes the interval.

resetDomains.interpretation: All domains reset; board strap levels latched.
Hardware-pin equivalent, relatches straps; selected despite table 8-1.
Restart digital logic; register settings retained, no strap reload. Inferred interpretation of soft reset in §7.4.4.2.
PCS reset; vendor registers retained and straps unchanged. Unspecified direct PCS membership requires fresh owned-field observations.

resetDomains.effect: MMD3, MMD7 and PCS; vendor registers retained
resetDomains.interpretation: Reset MMD 3, MMD 7 and PCS, retaining vendor fields. Invalidate standard EEE observations and any PCS-dependent state.

timings.conditions: External clock absent at supply ramp. Hold RESET_N low until this interval elapses.
power-up with initially unstable XI, figure 6-2
stable XI for at least 1 us during low
AN enabled; distinct from SMI readiness

reads.conditions: Channel A, powered PHY with a link partner. Acquire before applying the guide's categorical thresholds. Detailed fields, reset value and destructive-read semantics are not specified; keep access under the collector.

gates.conflict: BMCR says only pin/POR latch straps; PHYRCR hard reset is explicitly pin-equivalent. The PCS register set and the phrase soft reset have limited scope.
gates.decision: Use resetDomains, re-read owned direct fields and mark §7.4.4.2 digital restart as inferred.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm strap changes, five retention domains and optical recovery using TI clarification or identified board traces.

gates.conflict: Function 10 is called invalid and also demonstrated; the guide write example uses 401F then 0C50 as data. Table 8-13 says vendor range through 04D1 despite later wholly reserved tables.
gates.decision: Use only address function 00 and data function 01; preserve exact direct-only selector exclusions. 0C50 is data. Restrict 04D4 to the separately cited cable-break profile.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm post-increment and vendor upper range on silicon or with TI.

gates.conflict: 0462=4300 selects leader reference output even during software follower entry. Reverse sequence and reapplying prior lower mux fields are unspecified.
gates.decision: Preflight high fields [14:12]/[10:8], retain lower [6:4]/[2:0], restore compatible owned fields after restart (inferred). On exit, masked [10:8]=0 before restart is inferred.
gates.nextEvidence: Measure follower clock direction and both transitions under distinct strap/software entry with existing pin owners.

gates.conflict: Enable prose calls [4:0] a value despite a W1S bit at 4 and code at [3:0].
gates.decision: Limit code to four bits and model bit 4 as a separate action; example 2→9 is a relative 28 ns shift.
gates.nextEvidence: Request trigger/order and width clarification; measure XI/TX_CLK at both endpoints.

gates.conflict: 0457 appears only in qualified timing footnotes, without fields, reset value or reversal sequence.
gates.decision: Limit 0410 to the documented RGMII measurement condition with 0009=0002; treat latency as typical and preserve incompatible CR1 owners.
gates.nextEvidence: Obtain TI restoration instructions and identify fixture timing on both paths.

gates.conflict: IF/HF MII/RMII are documented; RX_ER mode 3 can encode RGMII plus signal detect without an explicit FX/RGMII operating statement.
gates.decision: Leave this combination open and test zero-I/O rejection of I/H FX; separate generic copper RGMII from P4 MAC admission.
gates.nextEvidence: Obtain explicit exact-part applicability or an identified optical RGMII trace with recorded clocks.

gates.conflict: The guide requires explicit restart to refresh FX BMSR; the tables describe link and SD drop without that exception.
gates.decision: Do not restart during periodic observation. Admit explicit digital restart then two collector BMSR reads; retain both. Treat lack of PHYSTS change tracking and no-SD soft reset mapping as inferred.
gates.nextEvidence: Capture link removal/return, BMSR and PHYSTS with and without active SD at Q14.

gates.source: SNLS505H tables 8-11/35; TI Linux 97becb13 and 7bd96b21, combined 450af114
gates.conflict: Linux masked enable supplies unshifted 1 for CR2[14]; 0040[13] force-link uses a generic label in the fiber register.
gates.decision: Position bit 14 as 4000. Keep force-100 indication distinct from an observed healthy link; copper applicability open.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm scope of 0040[13] with TI and compare FEF/force traces on each F grade.

gates.conflict: RECR is 16-bit saturating FFFF but its half-full event threshold is described as 7Fh.
gates.decision: Retain the raw count and actual MISR event. Derive no numeric half-full alarm or rate from the contradiction.
gates.nextEvidence: Obtain TI clarification or measure when the event asserts.

gates.conflict: The latched link-lost description calls 0001 BMCR although it is BMSR.
gates.decision: Route access to the BMSR collector; avoid incidental reads to reset the output.
gates.nextEvidence: Measure which read clears the indicated LED.

gates.conflict: Some named timers, thresholds and gain controls have only names or one tuned example, and 003F[7:4] lacks FUNCTION. Change history names 0124 while the current link-up threshold table and script use 0123.
gates.decision: Preserve named raw fields and published recipe. Infer neither safe arbitrary settings nor a 0124 alias. Fast AN timer table omits units.
gates.nextEvidence: Obtain per-field legal ranges, units, integration limits and TI clarification for missing cells.

gates.conflict: The guide references 0017 for lock and 0016[10] as lock; 3B04 also changes the loop selection from 3108. IPG calls its unit bytes while 7D is labelled 500 bytes.
gates.decision: Use 0016[11] lock, [10] read-clear loss, [9] generator active. Report raw IPG and capture bit 15 separately from count readback. Keep 030B opaque.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm restoration of 030B and exact IPG units, and measure generator/checker across a bounded error interval.

gates.conflict: Guide proposes an eight-bit amplitude divided by 256; field tables reserve bits 15 and 7.
gates.decision: Retain seven-bit samples, invalid samples, polarity and excess flags without a physical amplitude conversion.
gates.nextEvidence: Request the supported scaling and verify known open/short/cross/quiet fixtures with calibrated cable.

gates.conflict: Start, busy, sum, gain and accumulator fields exist; sum FUNCTION, conversion and post-start validity interval are unspecified.
gates.decision: Collect raw per-test data and mark uncertain freshness. Do not infer a cable length or recovery duration.
gates.nextEvidence: Get TI procedure, error bounds, timeout/abort and representative known cable measurements.

gates.conflict: Script deliberately writes reserved bits and whole registers. Register 0107 is wholly reserved; 04D4 is reserved R/W and extends above the vendor range described in REGCR.
gates.decision: Restrict every word to its ordered copper fixture profile. Coordinate other control owners, including 003F and optional EEE. Do not reuse values as defaults or independent writes.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm reset/replay, applicability by silicon revision and interruptible cleanup before admitting an executing procedure.

gates.conflict: Table 5-5 prescribes COMPT=0013 for harmonic content; the current exact table prohibits repetitive one/zero for that compliance measurement.
gates.decision: Keep repetitive one as a documented lab test pattern. Block the proposed harmonic compliance verdict.
gates.nextEvidence: Obtain a corrected DP83822 harmonic procedure with the applicable test fixture.

gates.conflict: 50/100 ms exit selections have no min/max qualifier, explicit proof of MDIO access while deeply powered down, or bounded interruption recovery.
gates.decision: Require IEEE down before deep entry; separate the selection, elapsed wait, positive readiness and recovery capabilities.
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm the exit path and timing from a known power state with the wired pin/MDIO and TI.

gates.conflict: RXFCFG[6] is named Bit Mask Flag without a programming contract. RXFS[12] description calls out MISR2 bit 1, while MISR2 assigns the status at bit 9 and enable at bit 1.
gates.decision: Preserve [6], leave setter gated. Track [12], MISR2[1] enable and [9] event; use 0800 only for an admitted wake-clear action.
gates.nextEvidence: Seek TI definition of [6] and capture wake-source and level-clear behavior for each wiring.

gates.conflict: PTPPSEL reset 000 has no function listed and 001/010 are reserved. GENCFG bit 1 is reserved but the feature recipe writes it.
gates.decision: Keep default routing unassigned. Scope 0456=000A to MII because bit 3 selects a 120 ns minimum IPG. Optional WoL affects RXFS[12].
gates.nextEvidence: Confirm routing after reset and qualify SFD timing/restore with both WoL choices. Obtain a source-backed SFD setup for RMII/RGMII.

gates.conflict: No table row covers 000B[11] or 0101[6:0]. The 0106[11] reserved row has no access label.
gates.decision: Keep gaps explicit and omit all three from ordinary writes; retain whole-word exceptions only in their cited recipe.
gates.nextEvidence: Seek corrected authoritative cells before admitting any general access.

gates.conflict: 04D1[3] selects bypass and [0] description also refers to enabling/ignoring standard registers. SNLA328 legacy LPI uses a DP83825-only reserved bit on this part.
gates.decision: Keep exact vendor and MMD observations with bypass state, constrain advertising to copper AN and use the documented MAC TX_ER route. No legacy 04D1[12] grant.
gates.nextEvidence: Verify both strap paths, AN advertisement and negotiated LPI on a capable partner.

gates.conflict: The exact-part register names number the MAC bytes from the opposite end to the leftmost-first octets in the application note. Some example captions also reverse the byte labels.
gates.decision: Use the DP83822 input octets and literal words in wireExamples. Apply password and pattern mappings independently.
gates.nextEvidence: Request TI clarification of MAC byte labels and check recognition and rejection with asymmetric octets on each qualified medium.

gates.conflict: The low-byte enables have type RC/W. The legend defines RC and R/W separately. Enable retention after reading a live MISR is unspecified.
gates.decision: Keep desired enables across collector reads and track installation as uncertain. Route the event byte and partial samples through the collector. Do not infer rearm timing or a lossless interval.
gates.nextEvidence: Ask TI whether reading clears enable bits. On an identified fixture distinguish retained, cleared and explicitly rearmed masks using successive independent events.

strapModes.source: SNLS505H tables 7-8..13 and 8-84/85. Entries follow four-level modes 1,2,3,4; X is a printed don't-care. A latched SOR code of 00/01/10/11 denotes mode 1/2/3/4.

strapModes.fx: In FX mode AN_EN/AN_1 are ignored. AN_0 selects half/full at 100 Mbps.
strapModes.mac: RGMII_EN,RMII_EN,XI_50: 000=MII 25 MHz, 001 reserved, 010=RMII leader 25 MHz, 011=RMII follower 50 MHz, 1X0=RGMII 25 MHz, 1X1 reserved.

operatingContract: Research dispositions only. The application owns traffic, pins, clocks and medium. One driver/bus owner serializes complete selector and RMW sequences. Read-clear, latch and mirror data pass through one collector. After partial action retain consumed evidence, mutation uncertainty and cleanup separately. Release the controller lock before waits. Check restoration of persistent state separately from transient diagnostic settings. Each of the four declarations needs its own runtime bind, negative cases and physical receipt.
